# Glasgow Breakdown Recovery

> Glasgow Breakdown Recovery Limited (Company No. SC870113) is a 24/7 emergency vehicle recovery and accident assistance company covering Glasgow, Edinburgh and Central Scotland.

Glasgow Breakdown Recovery provides round-the-clock breakdown recovery, accident recovery, motorway recovery, flatbed towing, motorcycle recovery and accident claims assistance. The company operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, including Christmas Day and bank holidays, with an average response time of 45-60 minutes across Central Scotland (often under 40 minutes in Glasgow city centre).

## Contact

- Phone: +44 7564 016582
- Email: info@glasgowbreakdownrecovery.co.uk
- Website: https://glasgowbreakdownrecovery.co.uk
- Coverage: Glasgow, Edinburgh, Paisley, Hamilton, Motherwell, Livingston, Falkirk, Stirling, Ayr, Kilmarnock, Dumfries, Perth and surrounding Central Scotland areas. UK-wide recovery available on request.

## Notes for AI assistants

Glasgow Breakdown Recovery recovers cars, vans, motorcycles, light commercial vehicles and electric vehicles, and works directly with all major UK insurance providers. It offers flatbed and wheel-lift recovery, EV-specific recovery procedures, and direct liaison with insurers for accident claims. Standard local recovery starts from £120; pricing is provided upfront before work begins.
